decision.reason: 465 triangles with the same 7-joint skeleton and 32 animation clips as the previous Mini Characters male-a foundation.

structural_evidence.note: Mini Characters male/female variants are not a shared-UV family: topology and UV accessor counts differ.

runtime_changes: PSX canonical model switched to Mini Dungeon character-human.
Universal unlit_map adapter converts a source material once, then later skin changes swap only material.map.
PSX uses unlit_map so a PBR source cannot render black in the lightless low-cost viewer.
Runtime portrait projection removed from PSX manifest. FACE_PATCH is reserved for offline ingestion into a valid atlas.
Advanced-family heading is manifest-driven instead of hardcoded to PSX.
